notes: Neural Maestro's Glitch Step blink is gone. It could teleport you straight into a crowd. In its place is Hologram Decoy, on the same button with about the same cooldown (5 seconds).

Hologram Decoy projects a glowing hologram copy of your hero just behind you. You stay exactly where you are. For 3.5 seconds, nearby enemies are drawn toward the decoy and attack it instead of you. Bosses ignore it.
The decoy can take 4 hits. When it breaks or runs out, it explodes in a neon blast that damages every nearby enemy and Glitches them. The blast scales with the skill's level and your damage bonuses.

Hologram Decoy upgrades: level 3 makes it last 1 second longer and take 2 more hits, level 5 gives it a bigger pull radius, and level 6 gives it a bigger explosion that hits 50% harder. Levels 2 and 4 add damage, and level 4 also lowers the cooldown.
The Lag Spike talent is now Persistent Projection. Each rank makes the decoy last 0.3 seconds longer and its blast hit 10% harder. Your existing ranks carry over.

The evolution is now Buffer Overflow. The decoy lasts 1 second longer and pulls enemies from farther away, and its explosion goes off a second time a beat later. No part of the Neural Maestro's kit teleports you anymore.
Soul Lure now also pulls in every experience gem on the map, not just treasure.

Class signature skills and ultimates no longer shake the screen. Their flashes and effects are unchanged. Signature skills affected: Paladin's Wrath of Dawn, Alchemist's Magnum Opus, Bard's Grand Finale, Blood Knight's Crimson Wave and Blood Moon, Chronomancer's Zero Hour, the Unraveler's Unravel, and the Druid's Tree Form Boulder. Ultimates affected: Rogue, Warlock, Ranger, Rift Dancer, Druid (all forms), Eclipse Paragon, Paladin, Engineer, Alchemist, Chronomancer and Unraveler. The new decoy explosion doesn't shake the screen either. Shake from taking big hits and from boss slams is unchanged.
Rogue, Ranger and Mage now deal 10% more damage with all of their skills and ultimates. Other classes are unchanged.
